chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"Make the shrouds of your deceased good, for they are their adornment."

key_terms.أَجِيدُوا: Make excellent; do well and properly
key_terms.أَكْفَانَ: Shrouds used to wrap the deceased for burial
key_terms.زِينَتُهُمْ: Their adornment; that which gives them dignified presentation
key_terms.مَوْتَاكُمْ: Your dead; the deceased among you

ai.seo_question: Why should the shrouds of the deceased be made good in Islamic teaching?
ai.summary: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام instructs believers to provide good shrouds for their deceased. The saying highlights dignity and proper care for the dead, treating the kafan as an honorable adornment for them.
